rfqRoute: A buyer searching for custom made product packaging is usually still defining the brief, so the first answer should not be a price guess.

The RFQ should define product category, product size and weight, packaging structure, material direction, printing area, finish preference, insert or protection need, artwork status, quantity range and target sales channel.

Custom product packaging can include folding cartons, rigid gift boxes, mailer boxes, paper tubes, paper bags or clear boxes, so the useful first step is to match structure to product fit and retail channel.
MUGE PACKAGING should route broad product-packaging searches to the quote checklist, then to the contact form with enough details for factory review.
After publishing, this segment should be watched through Ads search terms, GA4 key events and GSC query/page movement before bid or landing page changes.
